_method: Each crop opened and judged by eye. precision = correct / (correct + wrong); unclear excluded from the denominator. 64 crops scored (DIS_* files skipped).

electrochemistry.notes: Mix of charge-discharge curves, CV, LSV/polarisation, cycling capacity, Coulombic efficiency vs time, capacitance vs current density, photocurrent chronoamperometry. All are electrochemical measurements. Borderline-but-correct: electrochemistry__10.1002_adfm.201806662 (photocurrent density vs aging time, a PEC summary trend rather than a raw curve); electrochemistry__10.1021_acs.nanolett.8b02559 (photocurrent-vs-time stability with SEM insets, electrochemical axis dominates).

wrong_examples.why: Piezoresistive sensor response: dR/R0 (%) vs Strain (%). Electrical readout, not a stress-strain or hardness plot; cue fired on the bare 'Strain (%)' axis.
DIC/EBSD strain map image (colour overlay on grains, 'Strain (%)' colourbar). The panel is microscopy, not a mechanical test curve; cue fired on the colourbar label.

mechanical.notes: Borderline-but-correct: mechanical__10.1016_j.actamat.2020.116524 (Ashby-style stress-vs-strain literature scatter, not a measured curve, but the family is still mechanical testing).

thermal.notes: All TGA (weight % vs T), DTG, DSC/heat-flow or combined TG-DTA traces. No false positives.

optical_spectroscopy.notes: All carry a wavelength (nm) axis: UV-vis absorbance, PL/excitation, reflectance, transmission. Borderline-but-correct: optical_spectroscopy__10.1021_acs.nanolett.1c00178 (extinction coefficient k vs wavelength, ellipsometry-derived optical constant) and optical_spectroscopy__10.1002_adfm.201808885 (dissymmetry factor g vs wavelength).

wrong_examples.why: MISS of `mechanical`: a clean engineering stress-strain plot with 'Engineering Stress [MPa]' / 'Engineering Strain [%]' axes fully legible in the OCR boxes. Text-recoverable miss - the axis wording (bracketed units, 'Engineering') is not matched by the current pattern.

MISS of `micrograph`: colour-coded phase/orientation map of a grain (a1/a2/a3 regions). Plainly microscopy, but NOT text-recoverable - the only tokens are the phase labels, no scale bar or instrument text.

unclear_examples.why: Greyscale scanned map with x/y axes in micrometres; could be a confocal/scanning-probe micrograph or a photocurrent map. Technique not determinable from the panel.

none.notes: Correct `none` cases are genuinely out-of-vocabulary or text-free: a process schematic, S21 transmission vs GHz (VNA), Jsc vs light intensity, EPR (intensity vs H in Gauss), EQE histogram, magnetoconductance vs B, thermal conductivity vs T, a Pisarenko/Seebeck plot, an optical-trap position plot, and a 1 cm-scale photograph of a coated disc. Thermal conductivity vs temperature (none__10.1021_nl400558u) was counted correct because the `thermal` class is defined as TGA/DSC/heat-flow only; if thermal-transport belongs in that class it becomes a third miss and precision drops to 0.75.
